title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(廣光永兆研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Hiromitsu Nagayoshi)
keywords: Aeronautics 2.Combustion Engineering 3.Atomization and sprays 4.Environmentally compatible Engine 5.Regional alliance
educationalGoal: Based on the design and fabrication technology of the basics of aeronautical engineering and aviation engine learned so far, a basic ability to design, fabricate and propose feasible ideas on transportation machines by application of aeronautical engineering theory will be obtained. At the same time, students will learn the importance of cooperation with society (community in particular) to advance their ideas.
advice: The department of aeronautics aims to develop engineers who can support the development of transportation machines such as aircraft using knowledge of aeronautics, machine design, and production technology of transportation machines. Design Project III is the subject of the collected studies in the final stage of the curriculum. The targets of this subject are the following: -to develop the abilities of design and analysis through the designing of actual transport machines such as aircraft, applying theories of mainly aeronautics, and evaluating actual phenomena relating to the transportation machines such as aircraft. -to develop the ability to estimate the obtained results from the aeronautical engineering viewpoint. A detailed project theme is decided through discussion with the teacher. Students will discover their own problems and solve them. The example of the themes are described as follows: (1) Research and development of combustor technology for high power, high efficiency, and low pollution. (2) Experimental study on engine noise reduction structure. (3) Development of combustor concept design tools for new fuels and innovative combustion designs. Students must also understand the targets of this subject, and an overview of the content of the course and the objectives based on the syllabus. In particular, students must understand which part of the learning objectives of this department this subject carries and a detailed level of the achievement.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Because Design Project III is based on lectures, experiments, and practice of quarters 1-6 in the department of aeronautics, students must review them appropriately as needed.

activityGoals.body: Be able to establish a project theme and put it into action based on an engineering design process.
Be able to finalize the results students obtained in documents and conduct the presentation.
Be able to perform design, drafting, manufacturing (production) and simulation.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2) Students prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present and discuss it. Students prepare their research result as a final report and make a presentation and discuss it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting. In addition, students can report this final result in the scientific journal relating to their major subject and can receive outside evaluation. (3) Students conduct design and production activities on their own and use CAD and CFD tools actively as needed and can evaluate their performance.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Student clearly understands the purpose and the promotion process of the project theme and can achieve annual objectives that suit this purpose. (2) Students should prepare an interim result of the project as an interim report and present it. Students prepare the final result as a final report and present it in an open presentation and evaluation meeting.

lessons.assignments: Paper, Report and document search on the reference book relation to their major subject.
